verdict.rationale: Appwrite ships an official MCP server that lets LLMs act directly on Appwrite's API, and documents using Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Claude Desktop and similar tools to operate on your Appwrite project through natural language. Agent Skills and docs-as-Markdown support this by giving agents accurate knowledge of the SDKs and services. Natural-language operation still depends on a third-party AI client, and the scope of operations exposed is described only generally. Missing for 10: a native natural-language interface inside the Console, detailed documentation of which management operations the MCP server covers, and independent or hands-on corroboration that natural-language operation works well in practice.
